overview: The City Council Committee of the Whole met to conduct final interviews for the position of City Clerk and voted to recommend offering the position to finalist Laurel Siegel.

items.title: Resolution 25149: City Clerk Recruitment and Hiring Process
items.summary: The committee conducted public interviews with finalists Kevin Foley and Laurel Siegel, and subsequently approved a motion to recommend and offer the City Clerk position to Siegel. The Council also recognized and thanked Acting Clerk Rich Eliseo for his service.
